beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Trustworthy AI teaches how to justify reliance on an entire deployed system.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It connects reliability, fairness, security, and human oversight through explicit assurance claims.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The central question is what evidence supports a particular use under stated conditions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A model score cannot answer that question alone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers learn how to make confidence inspectable, bounded, and renewable when systems change.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same visible failure can originate in data, a model, surrounding software, or organizational practice.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book separates those four layers before choosing an intervention.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A changed index or review policy can alter behavior without replacing the model.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Looking only at model accuracy would miss those consequential changes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The course therefore organizes technical methods around the failures they are intended to prevent.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An assurance case connects a bounded claim with evidence and explicit assumptions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also records observations that would weaken or invalidate the claim.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A system update can make earlier evidence insufficient for continued reliance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book connects monitoring, adversarial tests, fallback, and human escalation with this changing argument.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Trust becomes a reasoned operational judgment rather than a permanent badge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with a specific decision the system is allowed to influence.
